name: mcp-remote-fs

tools.name: remote_config
tools.description: Get configuration information for the remote filesystem connection

action.description: Action to perform: get config info or test config

tools.name: remote_connect
tools.description: Connect to the configured remote server and test the connection

test_connection.description: Test the connection and return server information (default: true)

tools.name: remote_file_ops
tools.description: Perform file operations on remote files and directories

targetPath.description: Target path (required for move and copy operations)

tools.name: remote_list
tools.description: List files and directories in a remote path

detailed.description: Include detailed file information (size, permissions, dates)

pattern.description: Filter files by pattern (uses grep on ls output)

tools.name: remote_read
tools.description: Read contents of a remote file

maxSize.description: Maximum file size to read in bytes (default: 1MB)

lines.description: Number of lines to read (uses head or tail)

tail.description: If true, read from end of file when using lines parameter

tools.name: remote_write
tools.description: Write content to a remote file

content.description: Content to write to the file

createDirectories.description: Create parent directories if they don't exist

backup.description: Create a backup of existing file before overwriting

append.description: Append to file instead of overwriting
